title: a16z Podcast: The Present State and Future Possibility of Virtual Reality

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Our virtual reality-enabled future is arriving.
reader_summary.overview: Our virtual reality-enabled future is arriving. For example, beyond gaming and entertainment what applications does it seem like VR is best suited for. a16z’s virtual reality-obsessed Kyle Russell and Sakunthala Pandit are joined by perceptual and computational neuroscience expert Beau Cronin.
